Compares manager absence, missing target IDs, flagged targets, list order/ties, radius-256 strict edge, age-60 gate, speed caps and SSE turn arithmetic. Retail 4538f0 delayed turn also covers signed age/tail edges and both states. Production helpers are wired into ShotManager update callbacks 1 and 8; common factory/linear update have separate proofs. Full ECL lifecycle, native pointer ownership, all weapon timelines, replay and GPU pixels are separate. Additionally compares the actual ShotManager.invalidate_target path and the following homing update against a retail stale pointer whose ID is absent from a nonempty live list: one validation frame precedes target reacquisition. This avoids dereferencing freed port objects.
